top_signals.title: Optimizing Life and Finances in Your Twenties | Masters in Business with Jack Raines
top_signals.summary: Barry sits down with Jack Raines author of "Younge Money". Jack dives into his unlikely journey into finance and venture capital. He discusses how his travels impacted the way he sees money and purpose in your twenties. He also reviews how to incorporate passion into your career and the impact it will have in your long-term finances. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Donald Trump’s media company to terminate Crypto.com deal
top_signals.summary: The president’s company will unwind an agreement with Crypto.com to create a multibillion-dollar CRO treasury and reportedly not integrate prediction markets onto Truth Social.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
